summary: temporal-sql-tool currently exposes database passwords through environment variables or command-line arguments visible in the process table. This feature request asks for support to read passwords from a file via --password-file or SQL_PASSWORD_FILE for improved security.
userImpact: Users can improve security by storing database passwords in files instead of exposing them in the process table or command-line arguments.
proposedFix: Support reading the SQL database password from a file by setting an option like --password-file or an SQL_PASSWORD_FILE environment variable.
workaround: Use .pgpass file (PGPASSFILE) for PostgreSQL passwords, which works with temporal-sql-tool.
keyQuote: Both of these result in the password being readable from the process table (`/proc`). For defense in depth, it would be preferable to read the password from a file.
